paths.description: Homepage and navigation hub, representing the primary discovery surface.
Latest Jobs listing, representing category and index templates.
RRB Technician recruitment detail, representing job-detail pages and the path to the external application.
Site search for “railway”, representing the primary interactive retrieval flow.
Non-existent route, representing HTTP failure and recovery behaviour.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark-colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical to the light screenshot; computed color-scheme is “normal” and the CSS probe found no dark-mode rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and supply preference-driven dark surface, text, border, and control colours using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast and forced-colour preferences are not explicitly supported.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, while Lighthouse also reports colour-contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and preserve visible borders/focus indicators.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt and have no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet probe found no view-transition usage across the MPA templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin listing-to-detail navigation, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The homepage is 7,923px tall at mobile size, but the CSS probe found no scroll timeline/state treatment and screenshots show static chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight progress or scroll-state-aware header treatment where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visibly preserve location or direct attention after route changes.
findings.evidence: Listing and detail screenshots show no current-section marker, breadcrumb, or transition cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose current-page state and breadcrumbs on listing/detail templates; preserve focus after navigation.

findings.summary: A consent interstitial obscures the entire primary detail page on load.
findings.evidence: The mobile detail screenshot shows a full-viewport consent dialog covering the recruitment content before any interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, immediately understandable consent surface with equivalent accept/reject choices; do not obscure core content unless legally required.

findings.summary: Overlay behaviour relies on custom div-based dialogs.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found a DIV role=dialog for search and no native dialog or popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows and popover for transient search/menu UI, with declarative light-dismiss and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Responsive behaviour is viewport-bound rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero @container rules; reused navigation and content blocks rely on global layout styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable cards, tables, and navigation components where their available inline size varies.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on primary links.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe reports outline-style none and no focus box-shadow for navigation and content links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles with sufficient contrast and retain adequate touch target sizes.

findings.summary: Search and error states can end in an unbranded infrastructure timeout with no useful recovery.
findings.evidence: The railway search returned HTTP 524 and the error screenshot only offers Cloudflare diagnostics, not retry, search, home, or cached alternatives.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide branded timeout/5xx and search failure states with retry, home, and alternative navigation actions.

findings.summary: Mobile loading performance misses the LCP threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 9.0s, FCP 3.1s and performance 0.66; the trace’s lighter desktop-like run measured LCP 1.17s, showing condition sensitivity.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, defer ad/consent/analytics work, and retest under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: The mobile homepage shifts materially after load.
findings.evidence: The layout observer recorded CLS 0.174 with four shifts, including 0.128 at about 2.06s.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for consent/ad/banner content and stabilise font and image geometry before paint.

findings.summary: Resource delivery contains avoidable blocking and cache costs.
findings.evidence: HAR found four parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets, a missing cache header on the live image, and 1.32MB transferred; Lighthouse flags render blocking, font-display, cache, and dependency-tree issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, consolidate styles, self-host/subset fonts where appropriate, and set durable immutable caching on versioned assets.

findings.summary: Third-party and unused JavaScript dominate the page load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 550KiB unused JavaScript; HAR records 1.05MB script transfer, including three gtag loads totalling about 501KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics tags, gate ads/marketing code on consent and interaction, and load only the scripts needed for the current template.

findings.summary: Some links and data tables lack usable accessibility semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails link-name and td-has-header; the detail probe found eight tables with zero th cells and the image audit found two images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every actionable link, mark decorative images appropriately, provide meaningful alt, and add scoped table headers/captions.

findings.summary: Text/background combinations fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s color-contrast audit failed; the screenshots show multiple saturated colour tiles with white text that require per-pair verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust colour tokens so normal and large text meet WCAG contrast minimums in all states.

findings.summary: Heading semantics and focus visibility are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The homepage’s authored content begins at H2 while consent UI injects multiple H1s; focus probes show no outline on tested navigation links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one content H1 per page, logical heading levels/landmarks, and persistent :focus-visible indicators with sensible focus restoration.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s errors-in-console audit failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve uncaught errors and blocked resource failures, then keep console-error monitoring in release checks.

findings.summary: Asset and table markup quality is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The image probe found a 761px live image displayed at 62px and two missing alts; Lighthouse flags table cells without headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve correctly sized responsive assets and use semantic table structure rather than presentation-only cells.

findings.summary: The page requests notification permission on startup and triggers DevTools issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails notification-on-start and inspector-issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Request notifications only after an explicit user action that explains the benefit, and resolve the reported browser issues.

findings.summary: Some crawl and link signals are invalid or ambiguous.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports invalid robots.txt and link-name failures; probes found empty links and href="#" controls, although viewport and most real links are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid, fast robots.txt and replace empty/hash anchors with named buttons or crawlable descriptive links.

findings.summary: Robots and sitemap endpoints were not reliably available.
findings.evidence: Both direct robots.txt and sitemap.xml requests timed out at 30s, and Lighthouse judged robots.txt invalid; canonical and index meta were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Make robots.txt and sitemap endpoints reliably return valid content, then verify consistency with canonical/index directives.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but core security headers and cookie attributes are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; all three GA cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, CSP, nosniff and Secure cookie attributes; use the least permissive SameSite and retention compatible with the purpose.

findings.summary: The page loads a large tracking and advertising footprint before clear user choice.
findings.evidence: Trackers found 9 third-party origins and three known trackers; HAR attributes 31 requests and 1.20MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, deduplicate analytics, defer non-essential third parties until valid consent, and shorten identifiers/retention.

findings.summary: Notification permission is requested out of context on load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse explicitly fails notification-on-start. No authentication surface was present, so passkeys were not applicable to this path.
findings.suggestedFix: Ask for notification permission only after a user opts into alerts and explain frequency and revocation first.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: No frame protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP or HSTS was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff; test in report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.summary: Origin timeouts fall through to a generic Cloudflare page.
findings.evidence: Search and the synthetic missing route returned Cloudflare 524 pages with no site navigation, retry or alternative path.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure branded 5xx/timeout handling and cache or serve a resilient shell with retry and navigation options.

findings.summary: Mixed English/Hindi content is not prepared for language and writing-mode changes.
findings.evidence: The document declares en-US globally while listing content includes Hindi; the CSS probe counted zero logical-property uses and 234 physical left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark language changes, use an appropriate primary lang, add dir handling, and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Dates and numbers are presented in a fixed editorial format without locale choice.
findings.evidence: Detail content exposes English month/date and Western digit formatting while the site mixes Hindi and English and exposes no locale control.
findings.suggestedFix: Use Intl for rendered dates/numbers and preserve machine-readable unambiguous values in time/data attributes.

findings.summary: The consent dialog presents acceptance more prominently than refusal.
findings.evidence: The full-screen dialog shows “Consent” and “Manage options” as equal large actions but no immediate “Reject all” choice; core content is blocked behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Present accept and reject at the same level with clear purpose, vendor, retention and later-revocation controls.

findings.summary: An animated status image is substantially oversized for display.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found a 761px WebP displayed at 62px, over 12 times the required intrinsic width.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a correctly sized static or animated asset and retain explicit dimensions and responsive sources.

findings.summary: Duplicate analytics and advertising work is disproportionate to a text listing site.
findings.evidence: HAR records three gtag downloads around 167KB each plus ad, consent and push SDK scripts; third parties account for 91% of transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics, remove unused vendors, and defer background/ad/push code until it provides direct user value.

findings.summary: Third-party code consumes nearly the entire page budget.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 1.204MB of 1.324MB transferred from third parties, led by tag manager, ads, fonts, consent and push services.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, self-host only required fonts, and conditionally load vendors after consent or interaction.

findings.summary: Heap growth after repeated menu toggling is large enough to warrant leak investigation.
findings.evidence: Independent heap summaries rose from 303,122 nodes / 14.29MB to 387,139 nodes / 21.67MB after ten open-close cycles (about +28% nodes and +52% self size). Third-party nondeterminism lowers confidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Repeat in a controlled same-session baseline/target/final workflow, then remove retained listeners, detached nodes, timers or vendor allocations identified by retainers.

findings.summary: The static homepage has a high DOM/heap footprint for its visible complexity.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap contained 303,122 nodes and 14.29MB self size; a second loaded state reached 387,139 nodes and 21.67MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce injected ad/consent/vendor DOM and scripts, virtualise or defer hidden vendor UI, and set a memory budget for the static template.

taskList.title: Stabilise and speed the primary load
Make consent private, reversible and non-blocking
Add defensive headers and secure cookie policy
Provide branded retry and error recovery
Repair robots, sitemap and crawl affordances
